name: Rubber band assisted arm, 3:1
blurb: A #32 rubber band, wrapped round two standoffs until it is snug, pulls the arm up while the motor's 12T turns it 3:1 slower. The band carries part of the arm's weight, so the motor lifts more before it stalls.

name: Crank and rocker: 1-hole crank, 4-hole link, 3-hole rocker
blurb: The gear goes round and round, and the pin 1 hole out from its middle drags the link. The rocker can only swing back and forth. A longer crank makes a bigger swing. Use it for a waving arm, a flapper or a pusher.
